description: Compute context cost comparison using evidence-grade measured xLMP K data. The agent derives the economic implication; this tool performs the arithmetic from measured inputs. All claims carry tested_envelope, claim_boundary, and universal_claim=false.

assumed_full_context_tokens.description: Tokens per query if full context were sent. Defaults to min(corpus_tokens, 128000). Override to model a different context window size.

corpus_tokens.description: Size of the persistent corpus in tokens (est. tokens, not characters)

cost_per_million_input_tokens.description: USD per million input tokens. If provided, computes cost savings per query and per day.

queries_per_day.description: Queries per day for throughput calculations (default: 1)

name: vmn_context_cost_compare
